task:
A Shotcut project is open at /home/user/Documents/multi_track.mlt (1920x1080, 30 fps). Three source files are available: /home/user/Videos/video1.mp4, /home/user/Videos/video2.mp4 and /home/user/Music/audio1.mp3.

Actions required:
1. Add video1.mp4, video2.mp4 and audio1.mp3 to the project.
2. Place video1.mp4 on the V1 video track.
3. Add a new video track (V2) and place video2.mp4 on it.
4. Add a new audio track and place audio1.mp3 on it.
5. Save the project.

The saved project must reference all three imported files.

verification.description: video1.mp4 is referenced in the project
